role: Resolve implementation details left open by the prospective G5 scientific contract without changing its hypotheses, thresholds, primary statistic, null, or claim ceiling.

metadata_stage_must_not_read: any preliminary G5 colour distance or G5 test statistic
firewall.colour_stage_opens_only_after: the frozen G5 matched-set file and matching manifest are committed on the analysis branch

target_universe.species_identity: accepted binomial string in the species column; iNaturalist taxon id is audit metadata only

gbif_transport.paging: offset 0,300,600,... until the reported total is exhausted
gbif_transport.above_cap_rule: species with reported total >10000 are not evaluable rather than represented by a truncated occurrence sample
gbif_transport.request_retry_rule: up to 3 transport retries with fixed exponential waits 2,4,8 seconds; retries do not alter query parameters
gbif_transport.note: The Search API is the transport used to materialize the independent frozen GBIF occurrence snapshot; it does not change the GBIF source semantics of the parent contract.

inat_colour_record_exclusion.rule: exclude a GBIF record when its occurrenceID or references field contains an exact decimal iNaturalist observation_id used in the frozen global candidate-photo pool; if neither field exposes a matchable identifier, retain the GBIF record and record that exclusion matching was unavailable for that row

equal_area_grid.one_cell_dilation: 8-neighbour Chebyshev dilation in the 320x160 lattice with longitude wrap and no latitude wrap
equal_area_grid.sympatry_rule: at least 5 shared occupied cells and occupancy Jaccard >=0.10
equal_area_grid.allopatry_rule: zero overlap after one-cell dilation of both occupancy masks

realm.use_only: 100-km cell coordinates/indices and terrestrial-realm labels; WorldClim values in this legacy grid are forbidden for G5 matching
realm.column_resolution: case-insensitive normalized priority: realm, realm_name, biogeographic_realm for realm; cell_id if present otherwise reconstruct from longitude/latitude columns with the frozen 320x160 formula
realm.dominant_realm: modal terrestrial realm across occupied cells; ties resolved lexicographically
realm.missing_realm: species not evaluable for matched-set construction

chelsa_matching_climate.source_bytes: redownload exact verified CHELSA v2.1 1981-2010 rasters and require SHA256 equality before extraction
chelsa_matching_climate.species_centroid: unweighted mean of raster values sampled at occupied 100-km cell centres for each species
chelsa_matching_climate.standardization: for each of the four species climate centroids, z-score across all G5 occurrence-eligible species using finite values only; no colour information
chelsa_matching_climate.focal_difference_vector: signed standardized partner centroid minus signed standardized focal centroid for BIO1/BIO4/BIO12/BIO15

taxonomy.classification: relative to the focal species using accepted genus and family strings; missing genus/family is not evaluable

matching.unit: directed focal species x sympatric partner
exact_match: taxonomic distance class relative to focal
matching.candidate_controls: species in the 369-species target universe that pass occurrence/climate/taxonomy/realm gates, satisfy the frozen allopatry rule relative to focal, are not focal or the observed sympatric partner, and satisfy both exact matches
matching.continuous_standardization: the two log abundance/extent covariates are z-scored across all occurrence-eligible species; climate components are already global species z-score differences from focal
matching.distance: Euclidean distance between the sympatric partner vector and each candidate-control vector
matching.selection: choose the five smallest distances <=1.5; deterministic tie-break by SHA256(focal|sympatric_partner|candidate_control)
matching.set_discard_rule: discard directed matched set when fewer than 2 controls remain

colour_schedule_implementation.appearance_rank_rule: for every eligible species, collect its 20-photo palette vector in the chronological outer/slot order in which that species appears in the frozen atlas schedule; all species have at least 135 appearances, so use exactly the first 135 appearance-ranked draws for every species and discard a 136th appearance where present
colour_schedule_implementation.pair_distance: for each species pair, calculate Jensen-Shannon distance between the two species mean soft four-group palette vectors at each of the 135 paired appearance ranks, then average those 135 distances
colour_schedule_implementation.equivalence_note: Because matched-set deltas and focal/global averaging are linear in pair distance, averaging the 135 fixed draw-rank distances before the conditional label randomization is algebraically equivalent to applying the same within-set pseudo-sympatric relabeling across all 135 ranks and averaging afterward.

failure_and_recovery.insufficient_matched_coverage: scientific not_evaluable outcome; do not loosen thresholds post hoc
